notes.subject: hɛrɛ
notes.rationale: שלום ye hɛrɛ ye k'a sababu ke Kuma-Kelen-na dɔgɔya la; a kɔrɔ ka ca hɛrɛ ma

notes.subject: יוליכם
notes.rationale: Bayɛlɛmabagaw bɛ a jɛya: 'ka u wuli ka tɔgɔtɔgɔ' (kaa'u ɲɛsin juguyabagaw ma) walima 'ka u bila juguyabagaw la'

notes.subject: עקלקלותם
notes.rationale: עקלקל-daNɛ in daɲɛfɔli (root filan-ni) — Heburukan na a bɛ taminɛkɛdaɲɛ ye; Bamanankan na kokura-sira tɛ o fɔli di

translation: Nka minnu bɛ bɔ u siraw kokura-sira la, Yawe bɛ ⟨את⟩ juguyabagaw — minnu bɛ jugu bɛɛ baara kɛ — tila-tilali kɛ; hɛrɛ kɛra Israelya (Israɛl) kan.

tokens.gloss: minnu bɛ bɔ u siraw la
